boundary: PUBLIC SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT ONLY; zero protected original scientific first-use, zero native accepted model/weight modification, no merge/promotion, controller, scheduler or paid API.
scientific_question: Does prior weight-structure learned from earlier causal worlds improve prediction on independent unfamiliar compositional causal laws after exact-fit GF(2) weight programming has eliminated WSP148's greedy local training minima, relative to fully fitted conventional and independent symbolic controls with the same exposure, observation and whole-process budgets?

hypotheses.H1_exact_fit: On all 64 worlds and each 3 acquisition arms, exact GF2 linear elimination over 64 monomial weight bits fits all 32 own charged binary source effects (192/192 exact fits). This is engineering/representation capacity, NOT scientific learning.
hypotheses.H2_transfer: An empirical tokenless coefficient-prior memory built from 16 FIT worlds helps predict new unseen composite TRANSFER worlds compared with no shared memory and a deterministic mismatched prior, and surpasses the strongest information-matched fully fitted CART/prototype and algebraic symbolic controls on >=256 shared future queries.
hypotheses.H3_retention: Cold restore of the 16 learned world readouts, prior state and independent relabel must be exact with zero new source effect calls.
hypotheses.ablation: If direct numerical weights and independently computed same-prior symbolic solver yield identical predictions, numeric-specific scientific advantage is FALSE regardless of correct count. Present parity; do not claim unique mechanism.

numerical_model.representation: 64 coefficient bits indexed by each monomial mask m=0..63 of public six-bit typed x; prediction parity of all active m subset of x; no source law primitive, threshold, family ID or target labels in learner.
numerical_model.method: At each world, perform deterministic GF(2) Gaussian elimination on 32 actual observed (x,effect) constraints, with 64 candidate masks ordered by prior weight score (stable tie by popcount then index); set free weights to zero; back-substitute pivot coefficients. Verify 32/32 training fit and full coefficients with independent residual certificate. Never use greedy strictly error-lowering edits.
numerical_model.prior_learning: Start 64 zero counts and total_witness_worlds=0. On each one of 16 strictly earlier FIT worlds, solve exact row constraints from own arm, increment integer count for every active coefficient bit, increment learned-world count by one. This is causal-world-agnostic support-frequency memory, not library of known source grammar. Record full state and cold digest after each world. Learner must not know cohort generator/held test x.
numerical_model.transfer: Freeze prior once after FIT 16 worlds. Never update shared prior or look at scored held truth on 32 TRANSFER worlds. Each transfer world uses own 32 paid actions to infer exact local coefficients through trained prior ordering. Predict complete 64 outputs before any held coordinates revealed.
numerical_model.uncertainty: Produce exact 64 binary outputs for primary at first; report confident mistakes separately. Predeclared uncertainty diagnostic may compare exactly 4 alternative orderings (learned, baseline low-degree, fixed SHA256 shuffled, reverse), abstain unless all agree, but this is separate method named consensus; not silently post-result choose best.
numerical_model.cold: Store ordered 64 count vector, number of prior worlds, list of charged-row hashes and each FIT world weight state; restore and verify identical 64 readouts in 8 zero-effect opaque relabels (8*64=512) without additional calls. Tampering fails.
numerical_model.budget: Max 64 weights per model, no paid solver, bounded Gaussian elimination O(32*64*64) bit operations; measure whole acquisition+memory fit+readout CPU and wall and memory.

independent_controls.no_memory: Exact same GF(2) elimination with deterministic degree-first order and no FIT updates, identical own transfer 32 effects, equal readout.
independent_controls.permuted_memory: Exact same model but coefficient count vector deterministically permuted by frozen SHA256 mask order BEFORE transfer, no target labels used.
independent_controls.full_poly_symbolic: Original WSP147 independent 64-term GF(2) row reduction trained with same 32 transfer rows; must fit all rows; report if candidate differs on held or any x.
independent_controls.fully_fitted_CART: Original WSP135 CART fully fitted per TRANSFER world on identical 32 own rows; additionally FIT-exposed prototype matcher trained to completion on same historical 16 FIT worlds.
independent_controls.paired_numeric_greedy: Original WSP148 24-write one/two-bit strict improvement optimizer and WSP147 single16, same own rows, no source access; no postresult repair.
independent_controls.hierarchical_exact: Original WSP143 hierarchical learner and independent same-prior symbolic control, exact prediction parity, plus WSP135 latent, WSP142 direct3 and all-abstain negative.
independent_controls.matched_history: All memory-capable controls receive identical 16 FIT world observations; source outcomes from 16 FIT worlds are not counted as unseen transfer, and access is staged before transfer.
